story_info.title: Max Monkey's Sunny Treasure
story_info.subtitle: A Quest for Confidence
story_info.moral: Trying new things helps us feel confident and brave.

main_character.name: Max Monkey
main_character.appearance: Max is a small, energetic monkey with soft brown fur, a lighter tan face and belly, big curious eyes, and a long curling tail. He has an eager, wide-open smile.

slides.title: A Map for Max
slides.text: Max Monkey woke up with a happy smile. 'Adventure is waiting!' he called out. Today was a special day. Max had a map! It showed a treasure in Adventure Jungle. He packed a yummy banana. He was ready to go.
slides.speaker_notes: Max is excited for his day.

slides.title: Into the Jungle
slides.text: Max looked at his map. 'The treasure is near the big, tall tree!' he read. He swung through green vines. He jumped over soft bushes. The jungle was warm and bright. He saw a shiny yellow flower. Was this a clue?
slides.speaker_notes: Max begins his adventure, looking for clues.

slides.title: A High Clue
slides.text: Yes, it was! The flower held a tiny scroll. 'Look high up, near the buzzing bees!' Max read. He looked up. A sweet smell came from the top of a tall tree. It was very high. Max felt a little bit unsure.
slides.speaker_notes: Max finds a clue, but the next step seems hard.

slides.title: Max is Brave!
slides.text: Max took a deep breath. 'I can do it!' he told himself. He began to climb, up and up. His strong hands held tight. His long tail helped him balance. Soon, he reached the top! A small, colorful box waited there.
slides.speaker_notes: Max finds his courage and climbs the tall tree.

slides.title: A Sweet Discovery
slides.text: Max opened the box. Inside was a bright, shiny berry! He ate it with a big grin. It was the tastiest berry ever. Max felt so happy and proud. He was confident and brave. What a wonderful treasure hunt!
slides.speaker_notes: Max finds his treasure and feels proud and happy.
